findings.what: PLAN §0-i says the S02/S19 feet-POV is population 0 + body_parts {foot:2}; ep01 says population 1 + {foot:2}.
findings.why: L52 reads the arithmetic 'one body has two feet' — a headcount of 0 cannot hold 2 feet, so PLAN's value is checker-invalid and ep01's value is the correct one. But the common design (PLAN) and the episode design now contradict, and other episodes cite PLAN.
findings.fix: Correct PLAN.md §0-i to '1 + body_parts {foot:2}' so the common design matches ep01 and L52; the '0 (POVで足元を映さない)' parenthetical should name the case where no feet are shown.

findings.where: ep01.md:40 (人数 table), ep01.md:33 (場所・時刻)
findings.what: s02/s19 declare population 1 (the viewer's feet) but the viewer is not one of the 8 ledger characters, and no cast key for 'the viewer' exists.
findings.why: design SKILL step 6 requires cast = bare keys of ledger.characters and L8 fires on a cast that disagrees with population. cast:[] contradicts population 1; naming 送り火 is wrong (not yet in frame at s02). The second-person POV turns the viewer into a counted body with no character key.
findings.fix: Decide before ② how the viewer's body is represented: add a viewer/あなた entry to ledger.characters for these two POV shots, or record the cast gap as a declared hole. The 共通設計 does not cover it.

findings.where: ep01.md:33 (カメラは視聴者の目), ep01.md 仮ショット割り s02/s19
findings.what: The key_image for the two POV shots must be a first-person still (two feet over wet gravel, puddle reflecting black sky), and the design never states this.
findings.why: WAN 3.0 accepts any still as key_image, so the route is compatible — but if the baked key_image defaults to a third-person shot of someone's feet, the second-person premise breaks and the video contradicts the shot record.
findings.fix: In the s02/s19 key_image spec write explicitly 'first-person view, looking down; only the two feet, nothing above the ankles, no second person' so the POV survives into the still.

findings.what: Not using the ep01 scene board for the empty crossing (s01-s06) is correct; the design's label '雨/火/男' is imprecise.
findings.why: The adopted board #18 (採用表 ✅) shows 送り火 standing with the fire, and its own merged prompt says 'No rain falls' — the '雨夜' is only the filename; the crossing is wet, not rainy. s01-s06 need neither man nor fire, so reuse would leak them.
findings.fix: Keep the decision; reword '雨' to '濡れ' (wet) so the reason matches the board's actual spec.

findings.what: The 台帳 reference (#12 prop-sheet-台帳) is a closed dark-bound book, but s12b/s12c show pages being turned and the fire pressed onto the page.
findings.why: A closed-book design sheet will not fix the open-book key_images; the open state has no matching reference and must be carried by the s12b/s12c key_images alone.
findings.fix: Note that s12b/s12c bake the open-page state without a reference, or bake an open-page prop reference first.

findings.what: 27 new key_images for a 5-minute episode (300s/27 ≈ 11.1s per shot), 0 reuse of the 31 existing images.
findings.why: This is the WAN route's fixed cost (1 shot 1 key_image) and is denser than the pilot (ep03 = 27 new over 7 min). Feasible, but it is 27 generations + selection before any video.
findings.fix: Accept as the route's cost; sequence the bakes in shot order so the empty-crossing key_images (s01-s06) can serve as shared base plates if frames repeat.

findings.what: one-lamp-cel has no ## Motion character, so L20 fires ('Style Motion present but empty'); the design holds motion as a work constant and records the gap.
findings.why: Correctly understood/sequenced (C6), but the slot stays empty and L20 fires on all 27 shots until the author rules on adding Motion character to the distill card.
findings.fix: Get the author's ruling on adding Motion character to one-lamp-cel before ②, or accept L20 as a recorded retention across the episode.

note: The design is arithmetic-consistent: 27 shots sum to exactly 300s, and every S-row split (S12→3, S14→3, S15→2, S16→2) sums to its source duration. Population, body_parts, place/time and the key_image count (27 new, 0 reuse) are all decided and correct per the checker. The real risks are two POV-specific items — the PLAN/ep01 population contradiction (PLAN says 0, ep01 correctly says 1) and the viewer's body having no cast key in the 8-character ledger — both resolvable before ② writes the records; the scene-board non-use decision is correct.
